_note: The coach's advice (GDD 4.9.2, session C5). TWO parts. (1) `race`: his advice on a race: the pre-race plan (where to run: Lead / Sit in the pack / Wait at the back) and the kick plan, and the personality bias of his shouts in a watched race. (2) `suggest`: his 'Coach suggests' of meets and targets. All numbers and every text of both live here.

race._note: PRE-RACE ADVICE (RaceAdvice). The truth: a score per plan from the athlete against the field (measured with tools/advice_plan.gd, GDD 4.9.2 'Built (step C5)'). His view: score + his personality's lean + his error (sd = noise.floor + noise.per_point x (20 - race reading), times tactician_mult for the tactician, the most accurate), the best view wins: so a personality tilts the answer when two plans are close, race reading decides how often he is right. The kick plan: the athlete's natural kick point (races.json engine.player_kick) + his error (sd_m = kick.floor_m + kick.per_point_m x (20 - race reading)) + the personality's lean in metres (drill kicks from further out, calm and warm later, the tactician exactly), snapped to the nearest kick-plan option of races.json controls.kick_plans. His dice come from the coach, the meet and the round (the same advice every time the screen opens); the advice is never applied by itself.

shouts._note: The personality bias of his shouts on the cards (Race._coach_line). When he is wrong, which wrong answer he shouts is weighted by his lean in the card's direction (push / ease, data/race_cards.json coach.dir): weight = 1 + lean x lean_weight. On the judgement cards (`flip_cards`) he also shouts his lean answer instead of the sensible one with chance flip (not for the tactician).

texts.head: {COACH} SUGGESTS

kick_line.natural: And let the kick come where it suits you.
kick_line.at: And start the kick at about {m} m to go.

why.front_strong: You are the stronger runner here, and the pace is yours to make.
why.front_grinder: Your strength is the long run, not a sprint finish: run from the front.
why.front_crowd: A big field: the middle gets crowded, and at the front you have room.
why.pack: Stay close and keep your options; the race will come to you.
why.back_finisher: Your finish is your weapon: wait, and use it when the others are tired.
why.back_crowd: A big field: the middle gets crowded. Wait at the back, stay out of trouble and use your finish.

texts.used: Plan set. You can still change it.
texts.hint: Only a suggestion: it is your race. {His} view is only as good as {his} race reading.
texts.watch_hint: In a race you watch, {he} {v:shouts|shout} on the cards, as before.

suggest._note: THE COACH SUGGESTS MEETS AND TARGETS (CoachSuggests, session C5; user 2026-10-16). Each Monday morning he looks at the calendar; at most per_month suggestions a calendar month, counted with the 2 a week of CoachProposals. A meet comes when there is a REASON: `gap` (no race for gap.weeks), `tune` (a target 14-42 days later and no race between), `standard` (the next target needs a limit you don't have yet and your best is within standard.within of it). He judges the meet with the C4 verdict model (racing it against not racing it, CoachVerdict.meet_change) and suggests it when HE thinks it a Good idea (his seen total >= propose_min_w). A TARGET suggestion: a national or international meet you can enter that isn't a target yet, judged with CoachVerdict.target_change (the plan built round it against as it is), when his seen total >= target.propose_min_w. A suggestion is a message with 'Yes' / 'No thanks' (Ask me first: a stop; Always: the same, not a stop, a meet is never entered by itself; Never: he only writes it) and a mark in the Calendar with the same two buttons. A meet you said no to is not suggested again. max_weeks = how far ahead a candidate is played; after_weeks = weeks played after the meet. SESSION L1a: he looks on SUNDAY EVENING (look_weekday 6) so the coming week's planner shows it as a card (Yes / No thanks), never a stop; 'Always' is gone (it reads as Ask me first).
